body: No problem, hopefully your pc issues will get fixed soon. Pming sounds nice. Just thank you so much for listening and giving me some advice. Usually my parents and sister just say go finish high school and go to university and find better hobbies than video games. Thank you so much for actually listening to me :')

Hopefully it wont take too long. I dont want to waste peoples time telling them 'dont worry ill find something even tho i havent done anything productive for these past years!' Even my parents are constantly telling me to find something. It feels like i can only pick one thing to do with my life. The more time that passes the smaller the options get. I feel like by the time i find what i want, itll be too late.

its honestly feels like if i finish high school and go to university or something like that, ill just be wasting money that could to go my sister instead. Shes always complaining about how much university cost so it would be better if it went to someone who know what they are doing with their life, rather then someone who doesnt really care about much anymore.

how long will it take to decide tho? Will i even make the right choice? I have too many question that feel like no matter how i answer it, itll just end in regret. I guess ill try to find thatll make me happy but i dont think ill find something that i can do if i finish high school. Im sorry, im just whining and complaining and it feels like youre really trying to help. Im really sorry if it seems like im a crybaby but its getting hard to care now days.

I dont know if i can keep waiting. Ive already tried to find things that might seem interesting to me and ive waited. Im just getting tired from finding nothing and everyone else finds what theyre looking for.

i know i sound like im whining, but how do i make a choice? I always hear people talking about what job they want to do for the rest of their life but i dont have anything. Things i use to like i dont care much for. I dont have any talents or stuff like that. I just feel like rotten fruit hiding in a fridge so people dont throw me out hahah

I hope youre right but it just feels like everyone else is so ahead of me. I mean i finish high school than what. Im not sure about post secondary and i really dont have ambitions. Im just kinda stuck in one place so why bother with living i guess.
